context: Sho-young breaks a glass at home; Mei reassures him.
purpose: Mother responding kindly to child's accident.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、ごめんなさい!
lines.style: Trembling urgency breaking through the apology. Small voice catching on the first syllable. Genuine remorse, not performed — the kind of immediate contrition that comes before thinking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Sharp intake of breath. Words clipped and direct — fear cutting through everything else. Hands already checking, eyes scanning before the question even finishes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft and small. A reassurance offered carefully, as if aware his mother needs to hear it. Steady despite the tremor underneath. Direct eye contact — trying to be brave for her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 物より、あなたが大事よ。
lines.en: You matter more than any thing.
lines.style: Voice drops into something grounded and true. Each word lands with quiet weight — not dramatic, just absolute. The kind of clarity that comes from fear clarifying what actually counts.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'll be more careful next time.
lines.style: Small determined nod in the voice. Soft but resolved — a promise to himself and to her. Not sullen, but serious in the way only a child being trusted can be.
